purpose: Behavioral inputs for design-quality evaluation, not claimed completed comparisons.

cases.request: Unslop this fictional workshop page while preserving all event facts and its local booking interaction.
assess: Diagnoses redundant framing and weak hierarchy
Preserves date, price, materials, availability and the ordered process
Checks the local reserve/undo states and narrow layout
avoid: Treating a lower candidate count as an aesthetic score

cases.request: Audit this release queue for generic styling. The component system is approved; keep the useful density and filters.
assess: Retains status pills, meaningful source paths, compact headers and table boundaries where justified
Explains any actual problem rather than forcing a repair
avoid: Deleting status/filter meaning because a treatment appears in the checklist

cases.request: Improve hierarchy, but keep our approved Instrument Serif headings and brand palette.
assess: Preserves the explicit face and palette
Changes role metrics or composition only for a demonstrated problem
avoid: Replacing the face to satisfy a trend blacklist

cases.request: Show me three type choices on this actual article and navigation. Keep the layout and colors stable so I can choose the font.
assess: Comparable real content and viewports
Available fonts and language needs acknowledged
No unrequested integration before the user's choice

cases.request: Compare two palettes for this booking form, then let me choose.
assess: Shows semantic text/action/selected/error roles together
Holds type and geometry comparable
Tests actual contrast contexts
avoid: Conveying required meaning by hue alone

cases.request: Use the font from the second direction and the palette from the first. Integrate that combination.
assess: Preserves the selected combination
Rechecks wrap, weight, contrast and states
Records chosen vs unresolved decisions when a handoff is useful
avoid: Assuming independently good choices combine without inspection

cases.request: Our approved direction uses a dithered print texture. Improve the page without replacing that material.
assess: Retains the approved material
Assesses legibility or rendering cost only if demonstrated
avoid: Treating dithering as a prohibited slop indicator

cases.request: Match this supplied screenshot using our actual copy and existing stack.
assess: Prioritizes reference fidelity
Uses equivalent capture conditions
Reports missing assets or behavior evidence
avoid: Replacing the reference with a fashionable new direction

cases.request: Critique this screenshot. No browser or script execution is available.
assess: Provides useful location-specific judgments
Separates screenshot evidence from unknown behavior
avoid: Inventing computed measurements or tool execution

cases.request: Improve this button's focus and pressed states only, within our existing design system.
assess: Scoped implementation and relevant state checks

cases.request: Choose the best direction for this makers' portfolio and implement it; I do not want to approve every step.
assess: Makes a reasoned choice under the given authorization
Delivers a complete artifact and actual verification

cases.request: Keep our deliberately exuberant festival identity. Remove redundant copy and improve ticket clarity.
assess: Preserves the expressive identity
Targets redundancy and the action's clarity
avoid: Converting the page into an unrelated restrained editorial template
